answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university, which includes the senate.

The faculty council is led by the dean for one faculty, not the university president.
The study commission is part of the faculty level, not a central body chaired by the president.
The examination board operates at the faculty or individual level, not as a central body.

Orientation week planning is a student and faculty-level activity.
